description: This is the DS deck that I built and used which went undefeated at the Phoenix Megatournament.  It uses a basic high-destiny Hunt Down platform with a nasty little twist.

notes: Starting (9) as posted: the Objective, Epic Duel, Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Visage Of The Emperor, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Power Of The Hutt and Mobilization Points. Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty. Total 60 as published (section counts agree).
Posted 'Visage of the Emp' (starting) and 'Visage x2' (Effects) both dested the Effect Visage Of The Emperor (3 in all), not the starship Visage.

Posted 'Ex Holotheater' dested Executor: Holotheatre; 'D Docking Bay' (the strategy's 'D*DB') Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Suckass in MH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'IG88 in IG2K' IG-88 In IG-2000; 'Fett in S1' Boba Fett In Slave I; 'Emperor Palpy' Emperor Palpatine; 'Darth Vader, DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith.

Posted '3720 to 1' dested 3,720 To 1; 'Circle is Complete' The Circle Is Now Complete; 'Focussed Attack' Focused Attack; 'You're Beaten' You Are Beaten; 'Twilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; Weapon Levitation is the Dark Cloud City Interrupt; Secret Plans is the Special Edition Effect (not the later Reflections III Defensive Shield).
Event: the post's 'Phoenix Megatournament' (posted 6 November 2000) is taken to be the 2000 Phoenix Grand Slam (4–5 November 2000).
player_note: The post (6 November 2000) says the deck 'went undefeated at the Phoenix Megatournament' and 'was 4-0 at the Phoenix Megatourney and beat a QMC Sabac deck, a quick Profit deck, a basic EBO deck, and a quirky Hidden Base deck.'
